# Payment Due Terms

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List payment due terms

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/payment-terms/{payment_term_id}/due-terms`

Retrieve a paginated list of payment due terms for a specific payment term

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `payment_term_id` | integer | Yes | The payment term ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: paymentTerm, creator | `paymentTerm` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[value]` | string | No | Filter by value type |  |
| `filter[delay_type]` | string | No | Filter by delay type |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `created_at` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/payment-terms/{payment_term_id}/due-terms?include=paymentTerm&sort=created_at&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "GET",

    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

## Create payment due term

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/payment-terms/{payment_term_id}/due-terms`

Create a new payment due term for a specific payment term

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `payment_term_id` | integer | Yes | The payment term ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `value` | string | Yes | Due term value type. |
| `value_amount` | number | Yes | Value amount (percentage or fixed amount). Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 100. |
| `delay_type` | string | Yes | Delay type. |
| `nb_days` | integer | Yes | Number of days. Must be at least 0. |
| `days_next_month` | integer | No | Day of next month (1-31). Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 31. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/payment-terms/{payment_term_id}/due-terms" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "value": "percent",
  "value_amount": 100,
  "delay_type": "days_after",
  "nb_days": 30,
  "days_next_month": 15
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/payment-terms/{payment_term_id}/due-terms", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "value": "percent",
  "value_amount": 100,
  "delay_type": "days_after",
  "nb_days": 30,
  "days_next_month": 15
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/payment-terms/{payment_term_id}/due-terms', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'value' => 'percent',
    'value_amount' => 100,
    'delay_type' => 'days_after',
    'nb_days' => 30,
    'days_next_month' => 15,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```
